questions.stem: A must-do project may start only in 2032; the plan covers 2027 to 2031. With the code before the fix, what does CP-SAT get, and what does the planner see?

options.text: A row with no variables, which CP-SAT drops, and a plan without it
options.says: The page: CpModel.add adds an empty clause for False; nothing is dropped.

options.text: A TypeError from CpModel.add, and a crash with a traceback
options.says: The page: CpModel.add accepts a Boolean.

options.text: A constraint that can never hold, and an INFEASIBLE plan
options.says: Right: 0 == 1 is False, an empty clause, and the model is infeasible.

options.text: A must row that CP-SAT moves to the window's first year
options.says: The window has no plan year, so there is no variable to move.

origin.section: The First Trace Finds the Gap the Must-Do Change Left

questions.stem: A change adds two scenarios, and their tests are written; the change is not yet archived. What does the trace report?

options.text: The two tests, as tests whose scenario it cannot find
options.says: Right: the trace reads the living specs only.

options.text: The two scenarios, as scenarios with no test written
options.says: The scenarios are in the change, which the trace does not read.

options.text: Nothing, since the trace reads the active changes too
options.says: The page: the trace reads openspec/specs only.

options.text: An error, since a change must be archived to be traced
options.says: The page's run reports the tests; it raises nothing.

origin.section: The Trace Passes Only After Archive

questions.stem: A scenario in the living spec is renamed, and its test keeps the old name. What does the trace report?

options.text: Nothing, since the test still passes on the code
options.says: The trace compares names; it does not run the tests.

options.text: Only the scenario, since a test cannot lack a scenario
options.says: The old test now matches no scenario, and is reported.

options.text: Only the test, since the scenario's own text is unchanged
options.says: The renamed scenario has no test of its new name, and is reported.

options.text: The scenario as untested and the old test as untraced
options.says: Right: renaming without renaming its test breaks the link both ways.

origin.section: Nothing Links a Scenario to Its Test but a Habit
